summary: The consumer AI assistant landscape in 2026 is dominated by ChatGPT, which remains the clear leader with over 1 billion monthly app users, though its share of AI-chatbot web traffic has fallen from ~79% in May 2025 to ~54% in May 2026 as Google Gemini and Anthropic's Claude gain significant ground. Gemini has crossed 1 billion monthly active users as a standalone app, while Meta AI has leveraged its massive social-app distribution to also surpass 1 billion monthly actives. The defining trend is ChatGPT growing in absolute terms while losing relative share, with Gemini, Claude, and Meta AI tightening the race across both web and app ecosystems.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.pricing_paid: ChatGPT Plus $20/mo, ChatGPT Pro $200/mo, Team $25-30/user/mo, Enterprise custom
tools.monthly_active_users: 1B+ monthly app users (~1.2B weekly users, OpenAI)
strengths: Largest user base and model ecosystem
Voice, image generation, and code tools
tools.best_for: General-purpose assistant for everyday tasks, writing, coding, and research

tools.name: Gemini
strengths: Deep integration with Google Search, Workspace, and Android
Rapid growth in web traffic share (~27.9%)
tools.best_for: Users embedded in the Google ecosystem who want assistant help across Search, Gmail, and Docs

tools.name: Meta AI
tools.monthly_active_users: 1B+ monthly active users across Meta apps (Mark Zuckerberg, 2026)
strengths: Massive distribution via WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and Messenger
+60% increase in daily users since rebuild
Zero-friction access inside existing social apps
tools.best_for: Casual, in-app assistant use for people already on Meta's social platforms

tools.name: Claude
tools.pricing_paid: Claude Pro $20/mo, Max $100-200/mo, Team $25-30/user/mo, Enterprise custom
tools.monthly_active_users: ~245M monthly active users (9.2% web-visit share, May 2026)
strengths: Long context windows and strong reasoning
tools.best_for: Coding, long-document analysis, and professional writing tasks

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.monthly_active_users: ~100M+ (est.; 17% of US adults use it, Pew Feb 2026)
strengths: Deep integration with Windows and Microsoft 365
Productivity assistance in Word, Excel, Outlook
tools.best_for: Microsoft 365 and Windows users wanting productivity assistance in their workflow

tools.name: Grok
tools.monthly_active_users: ~117M (up from 89M QoQ); 8% of US adults use it (Pew)
strengths: Tight integration with X (Twitter) and real-time data
Real-time access to X content and trends
tools.best_for: X users wanting real-time commentary and an irreverent assistant

tools.name: Perplexity AI
strengths: Strong real-time web search and research
tools.best_for: Research and fact-finding with transparent, cited sources

tools.name: Character.AI
tools.monthly_active_users: ~20M+ (est.); 3% of US adults use it (Pew Feb 2026)
strengths: Customizable AI character and persona chats
tools.best_for: Entertainment, roleplay, and companionship through customizable AI characters

tools.name: DeepSeek
tools.pricing_paid: Free consumer app; API usage-based pricing
tools.monthly_active_users: ~360M web sessions (est. from traffic share, May 2026)
strengths: Strong open reasoning models at low cost
Competitive performance on coding and math
tools.best_for: Cost-conscious users wanting capable reasoning and coding assistance

tools.name: Poe
strengths: Access to many models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) in one app
Single subscription for multiple frontier models
tools.best_for: Power users who want to compare and access multiple AI models in one place
